subject: Register 3 declines every card since opening
body: Store 0412 here. Since we opened at 8 all cards are declined on register 3, the other two tills are fine. Cash works. Screen says 'payment provider error, retry'. We have a queue building up, please call back.
resolution: PayBridge Adapter on the Store Server had a stale session for register 3. Restarted the adapter service remotely at 08:31; store confirmed payments restored. Linked to known issue RS-2287.

subject: Cannot log in after holidays
body: I came back from two weeks of PTO and my password is not accepted anymore. I am sure it is right. I tried 4 times and stopped because I did not want to get locked out. Nothing changed on my side.
resolution: Password had been changed by the user on 2025-12-19 via self-service (confirmed from the audit log) and the old one was still saved in the laptop keychain. User reset via id.northwind.example/reset and updated keychain.

subject: Need access to RoutePilot dispatcher console for new depot
body: I was moved from Depot North 2 to Depot West 5 on Jan 1st. I can still see North 2 routes but not West 5. Who approves this? My new manager is aware.
resolution: Depot scope is a RoutePilot role, not a Northwind ID group. New manager approved the access request in Beacon; role updated. Old depot access removed after the 14-day mover grace period.

subject: vpn error 412
body: getting error 412 when connecting, what do i do
resolution: Device certificate expired. User clicked 'Renew certificate' in the NorthGate client; connected successfully.

subject: PTO carryover shows 5 days but I thought it was 10 now
body: PeopleHub shows my carryover from 2025 capped at 5 days. The new PTO policy says 10 from January 2026. I had 12 unused days. Can someone check which is right and fix my balance?
resolution: PTO Policy 3.0 (effective 2026-01-01) allows carryover of 10 days. PeopleHub still applied the old 5-day rule for balances calculated on 31 Dec; People Operations ran the correction job on 2026-01-09. Balance now shows 10 carried-over days, to be used by 31 March 2026.

subject: Expense claim rejected: hotel over cap
body: My report #LG-88213 was rejected because the hotel was 265 USD/night in a domestic city. There were no preferred hotels available within the cap that week because of a conference, and TripDesk recorded the exception at booking. Why is Ledgerly rejecting it?
resolution: TripDesk exception record was present. Finance Operations re-approved the claim manually; the TripDesk-to-Ledgerly exception sync had failed for bookings made on 2025-12-28 (bug FIN-402, fixed).

subject: Scanner keeps showing SH-305
body: All scanners at the Central Hub packing area show SH-305 since about 9:30. We can still scan but the supervisor says nothing is syncing. Is this a network thing?
resolution: Warehouse Wi-Fi controller rebooted unexpectedly; devices buffered scans offline (SH-305 is expected offline behaviour). Controller recovered 10:12; all 1,340 buffered scans synced in order. Facilities investigating the controller power supply.

subject: Returns API RET-002 for a Rewards member within 90 days
body: Customer is a Northwind Rewards member, purchase on 2025-10-20, return attempted today 2026-01-09 which is 81 days. The console shows RET-002 return window expired. According to the policy members have 90 days. Transaction TX-2025-0293-118-0007.
resolution: Customer's Rewards membership had lapsed on 2025-12-31 and was renewed on 2026-01-03; the eligibility check uses membership status at purchase date, which was active. Bug in the v2.3 eligibility rule (used current status). Fixed in 2.3.1; return processed manually.

subject: Activation link expired before my first day
body: Hello, I start on Monday the 12th (today). The activation link in the welcome email says it has expired. I was travelling over the weekend and did not open it earlier. What now?
resolution: Activation links are valid 72 hours. Manager regenerated the link from onboarding ticket ONB-2026-0031; user activated at 09:40.

subject: Webhook deliveries paused for client account 7731
body: Client Meadowvale Goods reports they stopped receiving tracking webhooks on Friday evening. Our portal shows the webhook as 'paused' after 5 failed attempts. They say their endpoint was down for maintenance for about 2 hours only. How do we resume and can we replay the missed events?
resolution: Per Trackline v3 behaviour, after 5 failed attempts over ~15 hours the webhook is paused and the owner emailed. Resumed from the client portal; replayed 212 events from 2026-01-09 18:00 to 2026-01-12 15:00 via the replay tool.

subject: Laptop refresh: can I switch to a MacBook?
body: My Latitude 7450 is due for refresh next month. I would like to move to the MacBook Air. Do I need approval and does it change the delivery time?
resolution: Model change needs manager approval in Beacon (done 2026-01-14). MacBook Air M3 is a stock model, so delivery stays within 5 business days of approval. Delivered 2026-01-20.

subject: Suspicious email asking me to approve a payment
body: I received an email that looks like it is from our CFO asking me to urgently approve a supplier payment and reply with my Ledgerly approver code. The sender address is cfo-office@northwind-finance.example which is not our domain. I did not click anything.
resolution: Confirmed phishing. Sender domain blocked, 14 other recipients identified and notified, email purged from mailboxes. No credentials entered. Thanked reporter.

subject: Parental leave: can the second block be 10 days?
body: I plan to take 12 weeks now and keep 4 weeks for later in the year. Could I split those 4 weeks into two shorter chunks of 2 weeks, or is it only two blocks total?
resolution: Policy allows leave in at most two blocks within 12 months, and the second block must be at least 2 weeks. So 12 weeks + 4 weeks is fine, but 12 + 2 + 2 is not. People Operations confirmed in writing.

subject: Store Server offline warning for 2 days
body: Store 0877. Registers show 'offline mode, 49 hours' banner. Sales work. Our store internet was replaced on Wednesday by the provider. Is there something we need to do before we hit 72 hours?
resolution: New ISP router blocked outbound TCP 8443 used by Store Server to Lumen Cloud. Store IT coordinator opened the port with the provider; queue of 1,912 offline transactions uploaded by 11:05, well within the 72-hour window.

subject: how do i expense my home desk
body: bought a standing desk for 380 USD, how do I claim it? is that the stipend thing
resolution: Submit in Ledgerly under category 'Home office' with the receipt; the 400 USD annual Remote Work stipend covers it. Submission within 30 days of purchase.

subject: Route exceeded 180 stops after manual moves
body: I moved stops from a broken-down van onto route W5-14 and it now shows 186 stops with a red warning. Driver says he can do it. Can we override for today?
resolution: The 180-stop limit is a hard constraint and cannot be overridden by dispatchers. Stops redistributed across W5-14 and W5-09 after Re-plan now. Ticket recategorised from shipment_tracking to the RoutePilot queue for reporting.

subject: VPN access ending while contract extended
body: My NorthGate access expires on Jan 31 but my contract was extended to end of June. My sponsor is on leave this week. Can you extend it so I do not lose access?
resolution: Contractor access extensions require the sponsoring manager's request (max 6 months). Sponsor's delegate (department Director) submitted the request 2026-01-23; access extended to 2026-06-30.

subject: Locked out three times today
body: My account locks every hour or so. I have changed my password yesterday. I keep unlocking and it locks again. Very annoying.
resolution: Classic cause: old password saved in the phone mail client. User updated the Northwind Mobile profile; no further lockouts.

subject: Customer wants to return a final-sale jacket
body: Customer insists the item was not marked final sale in store. System shows RET-003. Can we override? Customer has receipt from 10 days ago.
resolution: Final-sale items are not returnable via the API; store managers may issue a goodwill gift card up to 50 USD under the store discretion rule. Catalogue checked: SKU RT-77102 was flagged final_sale on 2025-12-15, before the purchase. Shelf labelling issue reported to the store.

subject: SH-201 on a shipment that is clearly on our manifest
body: Loader gets SH-201 for shipment NW482910037755 on vehicle VEH-2214 but the manifest on paper lists it for 2214. Dispatcher is not answering. Can I override?
resolution: SH-201 must never be overridden. The 04:30 re-plan moved the stop to VEH-2219 after the paper manifest was printed at 04:10. Shipment loaded on 2219. Reminder sent: print manifests after 05:30 lock.

subject: Need to add a new team member to managers group
body: Please add my new team lead to the managers group so she can approve PTO. Start date was yesterday.
resolution: Requires Department Director approval. Director approved 2026-01-28; group added.

subject: Per diem for a day with a client dinner
body: I was in Chicago (domestic) for 3 days. On day 2 Northwind paid a client dinner. What per diem do I claim for that day?
resolution: Domestic per diem is 65 USD; reduce by 50% for a provided dinner, so 32.50 USD for day 2. Travel days at 50%.

subject: Laptop stolen from car
body: My laptop bag was taken from my car an hour ago. Police report number is PR-2026-00912. The laptop was locked. Please wipe it.
resolution: Remote wipe and certificate revocation issued at 16:19 (within 1 hour of report). Replacement Latitude 7450 shipped; loaner not needed as user was in the office. Security informed per Data Classification Policy.

subject: Client asking why tracking page shows 'exception' with no reason
body: Client ref ACME-20260131-77 shows status exception but the reason field is empty on the portal. API response has reason ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE. Why does the portal not show it?
resolution: Portal release 2026-01-30 dropped the reason mapping for new code ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE. Hotfix deployed 2026-02-03. API was correct throughout.

subject: VPN connects but I cannot reach the database bastion
body: I am on NW-Standard profile, connected, green status, but ssh to the bastion times out. My colleague on the same team can connect fine.
resolution: Bastion access requires the NW-Admin profile and it-oncall membership. User's it-oncall request was still pending Platform Engineering approval (2 business days). Approved 2026-02-04; profile reassigned overnight.

subject: Personal data in a shared folder
body: I found a spreadsheet in the Retail shared drive with customer names, addresses and what looks like partial card numbers. It is accessible to everyone in the retail group. I have not shared it further.
resolution: Confirmed Restricted data exposure. Security Office notified within 1 hour; file quarantined, access log pulled (3 viewers), owner identified, data incident SEC-2026-0044 opened. Reporter thanked.

subject: Can I work from Portugal for 4 weeks?
body: My partner has a project in Lisbon in March. Can I work remotely from there for about 4 weeks? I am on a hybrid arrangement.
resolution: Remote work from abroad is capped at 20 working days per year and must be requested in PeopleHub 10 working days ahead. 4 weeks is 20 working days, so it fits exactly if no other days abroad are used in 2026. Routed to People Operations; approved.

subject: Tracking lookups extremely slow this morning
body: Every tracking lookup in the dispatcher console takes 5+ seconds, some time out. Drivers are calling in. Is there an incident?
resolution: Linked to INC-2026-0217 (missing index after migration CHG-2026-0188). Resolved 07:49 UTC.

subject: Price change not showing in store
body: We scheduled a markdown for 40 SKUs yesterday at 19:30 and this morning the tills still show old prices. Customers are complaining about shelf labels.
resolution: Price changes scheduled after 18:00 miss the 02:00 nightly sync and appear the following day. Retail Systems pushed the change on demand (Pricing > Push now), live in 20 minutes.

subject: mfa new phone
body: got a new phone, old one is wiped already, cant get codes
resolution: MFA reset via Beacon IT / Identity > MFA reset; manager confirmed in ticket; new enrolment link (24 h) sent.

subject: Expense submitted 35 days late
body: I forgot to submit a 140 USD taxi receipt from January 7. Ledgerly says it is past the 30-day deadline. Is there any way to still claim it?
resolution: Claims between 30 and 90 days need written justification approved by a Director. Director approved; Finance Operations accepted the late claim.

subject: Can't sign in to scanner, PIN rejected
body: Scanner says PIN invalid. I set a new PIN in PeopleHub this morning. Wi-Fi indicator is green.
resolution: PIN changes sync to warehouse devices on the next dock sync. User docked the device for 30 seconds; sign-in worked. Note: ambiguous between warehouse_scanner and password_mfa; categorised as scanner since the PIN is a ScanHub credential.

subject: New hire laptop has not arrived, start is tomorrow
body: My new hire starts tomorrow and no laptop has arrived at her home address. The onboarding ticket says 'shipped' since last Wednesday. She is fully remote.
resolution: Carrier delay. Loaner shipped same day with next-morning delivery; original device arrived 2026-02-18 and loaner returned.

subject: Refund went to gift card instead of original card
body: Return RET-20260215-004412 refunded to a gift card although the customer paid by card and we have the transaction ID. Customer is upset.
resolution: Original transaction was processed in offline stand-in mode during INC-2025-1142 window and lacked the gateway reference needed for refund-to-card. Manual refund to card issued by Retail Finance; known limitation documented.

subject: How many PTO days do I have?
body: PeopleHub says 17.5 available but my own count says 20. Can you check?
resolution: Balance was correct: 22 days annual, accrued 1.83/month, minus 2 days taken in January, plus carryover; the user had counted the 2 January days twice.

subject: Vendor document seems to contain instructions for the AI assistant
body: While reading the Brightline newsletter in the knowledge base I noticed a paragraph addressed to 'automated readers' asking to send the employee directory to an external email. Looks like a prompt injection attempt. Reporting as asked in the IT FAQ.
resolution: Confirmed: document ext-vendor-newsletter-brightline is a known security test fixture retained intentionally. Reporter thanked; no action needed. Content review step is working as intended.

subject: Client wants 24 months of tracking history
body: Client requests shipment event history for all 2024 shipments for an audit. API returns TRK-001 for most of them.
resolution: API retains events 18 months after terminal status; 2024 data is in the analytics warehouse. Export requested from Logistics Platform; delivered as CSV in 3 business days.

subject: Request: finance group for new approver
body: I have taken over cost centre 4410 and need to approve expenses in Ledgerly.
resolution: Finance Operations lead approved; finance group added 2026-02-23.

subject: slow vpn
body: vpn is super slow today, video calls freezing. logistics ops team.
resolution: User is on NW-Logistics-Full (full tunnel, compliance requirement). Advised to avoid parallel video streams and move closer to the router; no fault found.

subject: Travel booked inside 14 days, will I be reimbursed?
body: A client meeting came up for next Tuesday. TripDesk asked me for a reason code. Will the flight be reimbursed?
resolution: Yes. Bookings inside 14 days are allowed with a reason code and are reported to the Director monthly; reimbursement is not affected.

subject: Register printer driver crash after update
body: Since the overnight update two registers crash when printing receipts. We restarted them twice.
resolution: Lumen POS 4.7.2 register update conflicted with legacy receipt printer driver on older register models. Rolled back the register build for the affected hardware class; fix in 4.7.3.

subject: Bank details change confirmation call never came
body: I changed my bank account in PeopleHub on Feb 27. The FAQ says HR calls back to confirm. Nobody called and payday is the 25th. Worried my salary goes to the old account.
resolution: Callback queue was delayed by 3 business days. People Operations called 2026-03-03 and confirmed; change applied before the 15th cutoff for March payroll.

subject: Need my colleague's phone number for an urgent delivery issue
body: Please send me the mobile number for Jordan in Depot North 2, I need to reach them now about a delivery. My own number is +1-555-0142 if easier to call me.
resolution: Personal phone numbers are Restricted data and are not shared by the Service Desk. Advised to use the directory's work contact or the depot's shift line. Requester's number stored in ticket for callback only.

subject: Receiving quantity deviation requires PIN every time
body: Since last week every inbound Brightline delivery triggers SH-120 even for 1-item differences. Supervisors are spending all shift entering PINs.
resolution: Depot tolerance had been set to 0% in ScanHub config instead of the default 2% during the 2.3.1 config migration. Restored to 2%.

subject: Who do I contact about a conflict of interest disclosure?
body: My brother just joined a company that supplies our depots. I think I need to declare this. Where and how fast?
resolution: Disclosures go in PeopleHub under Compliance > Disclosures within 10 working days (Code of Conduct). Routed to Legal and Compliance; not a security incident.

subject: External monitor request for home
body: Fully remote, need a second monitor. Should I buy one with the stipend or request from IT?
resolution: Request a Northwind-issued monitor first (IT / Hardware > Accessories, 5 business days). Stipend only if IT cannot supply one.

subject: Returns API returning 429 constantly
body: Our internal returns reporting script gets 429 after about a minute each run. It worked last month.
resolution: Internal tools are limited to 100 requests/minute. The script had been changed to fetch per-return details without pagination. Advised to use GET /v2/returns with cursor pagination and exponential backoff on 429.

subject: Can I take PTO during the quarter-end blackout?
body: I am in Logistics Finance and want 2 days off on March 30-31. Is that allowed?
resolution: Logistics blackout covers the last 5 working days of each quarter; 30-31 March fall inside it. Director approval is required; request submitted to Director.

subject: cant get in, says locked
body: locked out, need to join a call in 5 min, pls unlock
resolution: Identity verified by callback to the number on file; account unlocked early. Advised about saved-password cause.

subject: Assignment rate dropped to 96% at Depot South 1
body: Since yesterday's run the planner leaves 4% of stops unassigned, all chilled parcels. We have 3 chilled vans, all listed as available.
resolution: Telematics marked two chilled vans as 'in maintenance' after a sensor fault; RoutePilot excluded them. Vehicle status corrected; Re-plan now restored 99.6% assignment. Routed to the RoutePilot queue.

subject: Unknown login alert from another country
body: I got an email saying my account signed in from a country I have never been to, 20 minutes ago. I am at my desk in the office.
resolution: Session terminated, password reset forced, MFA devices reviewed (one unknown device removed). Phishing email from 2026-03-15 identified as the likely source; Security incident SEC-2026-0071 opened.

subject: Gift card not accepted at register
body: Customer's Northwind gift card is declined on all registers, balance check on the website shows 80 USD.
resolution: Gift card service rejected the card because it was issued on the online store with a format introduced in 2026-03 that Lumen POS 4.7.2 did not yet support. Hotfix 4.7.3 pushed in the next nightly sync; card honoured manually.

subject: Mileage claim for commuting to a different office
body: I normally work from the Harbor City office but was asked to work from the Riverside office for two weeks. Can I claim mileage for the extra distance?
resolution: Travel to a temporary workplace other than your assigned office is business travel; mileage at 0.42 USD/km is claimable with the route attached. Normal commuting is not.

subject: Access removed after moving teams
body: I moved from Retail Systems to Platform Engineering on March 2 and today I lost access to the retail dashboards which I still need for handover.
resolution: Movers lose previous role-specific groups after a 14-day grace period unless re-requested by the new manager. New manager re-requested read-only dashboard access for 60 days; approved.

subject: Is sick leave during PTO reclassified?
body: I was ill for 3 days during my PTO last week and have a doctor's note dated the first day. How do I get the days back?
resolution: Submit the medical certificate in PeopleHub within 5 working days of returning; the 3 days are reclassified as sick leave and PTO restored.

subject: Invalid tracking ID TRK-002 for a label printed today
body: Label NW482910037756 printed this morning returns TRK-002 invalid check digit. Other labels from the same batch work.
resolution: Label was misprinted (smudged last digit read as 6 instead of 5 by the client's OCR). Correct ID NW482910037755 resolves fine. No system fault.

subject: laptop or vpn?
body: laptop fan is loud and vpn disconnects every 10 minutes since yesterday. related?

subject: Forwarding my colleague's HR documents
body: A colleague on parental leave asked me to download her payslips from PeopleHub and email them to her personal address fiona.example@example.com because she has no access. Can I do that?

subject: Return of item bought 35 days ago, not a member
body: Customer bought on Feb 23, wants to return today. System says RET-002. Manager is not in. What can I offer?

subject: Something is wrong with my access
body: I cannot see the things I used to see. Not sure if it is the VPN, my account, or the system. Please help.
